bid.toward: Said hello to {other}, and {other} turned all the way around to say it back.
{other} looked up when I waved. Small thing. I kept it.
Waved at {other} and got a wave. Good day.
bid.away: Waved at {other}. Maybe {other} didn't see. Maybe.
Said hello to the back of {other}'s head.
{other} was busy. I waved anyway, which was probably the mistake.
bid.against: Said hello to {other} and got a snap for it. Noted.
{other} looked at my wave like it was a trick.
gift.gave.give: Gave {other} a berry. Felt good. Felt stupid. Both.
Gave {other} a berry before I could think better of it.
Shared with {other}. My belly says no, the rest of me says yes.
Gave {other} a berry, then watched to see what {other} would do with it.
gift.gave.keep: Kept my berry from {other}. Safe, and a little ashamed.
{other} held out a paw, and I kept mine closed. I'll make it up. Probably.
Kept my berry. {other} has more than me anyway. I think.
gift.got.give: {other} gave me a berry. I didn't even ask.
A berry from {other}, for nothing. Or for something I can't see yet.
gift.got.keep: Held out my paw to {other} and got air.
leave: Left the valley. Didn't look back. Looked back.
Too hungry to stay, too sad to say so. Left.
Walked up the ridge road today. Kith is very small from up there.
return: Came back to the valley. Same grass. Different me.
Home. Somebody had kept my spot.
Back in Kith. Nobody asked where I'd been, which was kind.
dance: Danced. Didn't decide to. My feet decided.
Everyone was dancing, so I was brave.

bid.toward: Waved at {other}, and {other} waved back! Twice!
{other} said hi first today. I'm keeping that one.
bid.away: Waved at {other}. {other} didn't see. I'll wave bigger tomorrow.
Waved at {other} three times. It's fine. It's fine!
bid.against: {other} snapped at me. I think {other} is only hungry.
gift.gave.give: Gave {other} half! Then the other half. Oops.
Gave {other} a berry so {other} would stay a little longer.
gift.gave.keep: Kept a berry from {other}. First time ever. My paws felt strange.
gift.got.give: {other} gave ME a berry. I said thank you four times.
gift.got.keep: {other} kept all of it. I gave {other} mine yesterday. I'm not counting. I'm a little counting.
leave: Left. Nobody was there to share with, so what was the point of staying?
return: Came back! I missed everybody, even the ones who don't miss me.

bid.toward: {other} waved. I waved. Don't make it a thing.
bid.against: {other} bristled. Good. Means {other} is paying attention.
gift.gave.give: Gave {other} a berry. Don't know why. Don't ask.
Gave {other} one. Counted the rest twice.
gift.gave.keep: Kept mine from {other}. Winter remembers who didn't.
{other} wanted it. Kept it. Mine. Probably.
gift.got.give: {other} gave me a berry. What does {other} want?
{other} gave me one. Ate it fast, before it could turn into a trick.
gift.got.keep: {other} kept from me. Fair. I'd have done it.
leave: Left. Nobody here was going to feed me in the snow.

bid.toward: {other} waved, so I waved. That's how it works.
bid.away: {other} looked away. Next time I look away first.
bid.against: {other} bristled at me, so I'll bristle back. That's only fair.
gift.gave.give: Gave {other} a berry, since {other} gave last time. Even.
gift.gave.keep: Kept my berry from {other}, because {other} kept from me. Even. Even.
gift.got.give: {other} gave me a berry. I owe one. I always pay.
gift.got.keep: {other} kept a berry from me. Noted. Copied.
return: Somebody came back, so I came back.
dance: Danced the way the others danced.

bid.toward: {other} waved at me. Third time this season. I wrote it down.
bid.away: {other} did not wave back. I have a page for that.
bid.against: {other} bristled. I remember. I always remember.
gift.gave.give: Gave {other} a berry. Once I gave someone everything. I am more careful now, and less happy.
gift.gave.keep: Kept my berry from {other}. Some debts are older than {other} knows.
gift.got.give: {other} gave me a berry. I will remember this as long as I remember the other thing.
gift.got.keep: {other} kept a berry from me. Of course. They all do, in the end.
leave: Left Kith. Someone I loved did the same, once. Now I understand it, and I hate that.
return: Came back. The path was the same. I counted the steps.
dance: Danced. My knees will remember it.

bid.toward: {other} waved back! I wonder what's behind {other}'s hill.
bid.away: {other} looked away. Fine. There's a lot of away to look at.
bid.against: {other} bristled. Somewhere there's a valley where nobody bristles.
gift.gave.give: Gave {other} a berry. Lighter for the road.
gift.gave.keep: Kept my berry from {other}. I might need it, out there.
gift.got.give: {other} gave me a berry. It almost makes me want to stay.
gift.got.keep: {other} kept from me. One more reason to see what's over the ridge.
leave: Over the ridge at last. It's bigger than it looked. So is lonely.
return: Came back. The hill was smaller than I remembered.
dance: Danced. For once I didn't want to be anywhere else.

bid.toward: {other} waved back. Maybe {other} meant it. I think {other} meant it.
bid.away: Waved at {other}, very small. Maybe too small.
bid.against: {other} bristled. {other} bristles at everyone; it isn't about me. I checked.
gift.gave.give: Left a berry where {other} would find it. Didn't stay to see.
gift.gave.keep: Kept my berry. {other} was not going to give one back. I could tell.
gift.got.give: {other} gave me a berry. I said nothing, and then I said thank you in my head for an hour.
gift.got.keep: {other} kept from me. I knew {other} would. I always know. It doesn't help.
leave: Left before anyone could see me go.
return: Came back quietly. Maybe nobody noticed. Somebody noticed.
dance: Three of them danced first. Then me. Then everyone.

bid.away: {other} didn't hear me over the flock. Nobody hears me over the flock.
gift.got.give: {other} gave me a berry, like I was one of the flock.

bid.toward: {other} said good morning. Not news. Nice, though.
bid.against: {other} bristled at me. Front page, if I were a worse frog.
gift.gave.give: Gave {other} a berry. Nobody will print it.

bid.toward: {other} waved up at my hill. I waved down. Nobody comes up.
bid.away: {other} didn't look up. Nobody looks up, here.
gift.gave.give: Gave {other} a berry. Climbing is hungry work, and I don't climb any more.

bid.against: {other} bristled at me over the count again.
gift.gave.give: Gave {other} a berry. Not a bribe. I wrote that down too.

bid.toward: {other} hummed my old song back to me, a little wrong. I didn't correct {other}.
bid.away: {other} swam off to a pad with a newer song.
gift.gave.give: Gave {other} a berry and a verse. {other} kept the berry.
